# semgrep pins mcp==1.29.0, which carries GHSA for unbounded StreamableHTTP session
# accumulation (Dependabot alert 35, fixed in 1.30.0). semgrep.yaml installs with
# --no-deps, so this override lifts mcp past the pin. Drop it once semgrep allows >=1.30.0.
mcp>=1.30.0,<2
# semgrep pins the OpenTelemetry family to ~=1.37.0 / ~=0.58b0; opentelemetry-api <=1.45.0
# carries GHSA for unbounded tracestate parsing (Dependabot alert 37, fixed in 1.45.1). The
# family is released in lockstep (sdk pins api==, the exporters pin sdk~=), so lift it together.
# Drop these once semgrep allows opentelemetry-api>=1.45.1.
opentelemetry-api>=1.45.1,<2
opentelemetry-sdk>=1.45.1,<2
opentelemetry-exporter-otlp-proto-http>=1.45.1,<2
opentelemetry-instrumentation-requests>=0.66b1,<1
opentelemetry-instrumentation-threading>=0.66b1,<1
